name: Oneshot Paper
tagline: oneshot-video's paper palette: near-black ground, warm off-white type, one coral, 1.00/1.12 cut-zooms and ticks.

motion.direction: oneshot-video `paper`. Sentence case, one family two weights (Inter 500/800) and ONE Instrument Serif italic voice-switch word; warm off-white `iv` on a near-black ground, coral `ter` the only accent, a 2 px hairline. Captions: word-timed pages, karaoke with unspoken words at 60 %, ≤ 1 emphasised word on ≤ 20 % of pages, never over the face. Camera `cutZoom` alternates 1.00 / 1.12 per segment, punch-ins 1.08–1.15 at most 2–4 per minute. Graphics one at a time: a `chapterCard` as HookBar in the first 3–6 s, `chips` beside the head 100–200 ms before the term, a `counter` counting up 0.8 s with an accent underline, a `strikeLine` swap-quote. A visual change every 3–6 s — 1.5 s cadence reads as frantic. Film grain 0.06.
